notes: Round-2 independent audit, 2026-10-11: The old gap (gate not installed in qip-edge-node; reprice::replace ungated) is closed. New defect: Market Factory quotes bypass every pre-trade limit, and the 'fails on a new unguarded one' enumeration is still a text search that misses it. Capital findings on the gates themselves: the cell's Risk Gate counts every working order at its remaining size and its own (requoted) limit price (cell.rs:5420-5447; record_replacement updates the price, cell.rs:9938-9948) and checks the order at the price it is sent at — good; held positions are priced at the last price the gate saw an order sent at (risk_gate.rs:76-79, :193-197), not a current mark, so gross can be understated after a move. Region hold (edge): reserved at the strategy's mid, quantity*price where price is the mid (edge/qip-edge/src/cell.rs:4749-4757, :4932), but the order is sent at the touch for Marketable (cell.rs:5660) or at a later requote price (apps/qip-edge-node/src/reprice.rs:770-793); the hold is committed whole at the mid notional (cell.rs:5172) and never re-taken at the sent price, so the region allocation under-counts a marketable buy by the half-spread and a requote that chases the touch by however far it moves. It does keep working orders: the committed hold stays on Working::region_committed until fill/expiry. At the desk, the projection prices the order at arrival_price, not the fill price including impact (oms.rs:731), and RiskState carries no working orders (platform.rs:16572); latent today because stage_act sends Market orders that the simulator fills whole (platform.rs:15361).
